summary: Cleanup helper on a pointer array: frees the dual-pointer block at this+5 via DualPointerFree, then frees the single pointer at this+2 via FreeIfNonNull and returns the latter's result. operations.description: Call DualPointerFree(this + 5), freeing the dual-pointer pair stored 5 LPVOID elements (20 bytes) into the array.
Call FreeIfNonNull(this + 2), freeing the single pointer stored 2 LPVOID elements (8 bytes) into the array.
